items.item: Actual isolated OpenCode server, credentials, child-process termination and workspace boundary
items.note: opencode 1.17.13, real model turns (opencode-go/glm-5.3-flash) through OpenCodeDriver, scripts/opencode_qualify.py (Work 017). Host-side server: 6/9. In the sandbox (pinned amplai-worker-opencode image on the qualified egress profile, --container): 8/9 pass; egress used only opencode.ai:443 (github/npm/example.com denied), SIGKILL of the container ends the tool tree and the exact session resumes without prompt replay. Remaining fail secret_isolation: opencode serve takes its password only from OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD and the bash tool inherits it, in the container too. crash resume turn is a raw HTTP prompt, not OpenCodeDriver.resume. The model catalog is seeded because models.dev is not allowlisted. Work 017 also fixed two driver defects found only with the real server (non-ascending messageID caused endless reply regeneration; gzip bodies decoded twice).

items.item: Real docker/podman containment, egress, resource and credential isolation
items.note: colima + docker 29.5; image pinned by registry digest. Egress is real: the agent joins only an --internal network and an allowlist CONNECT sidecar is the sole route out (deployment/local-egress-qualification.json, tests/v3/test_rc04_egress_container.py). Credential isolation of real claude and codex turns measured (Work 016, 9/9 each). Resource limits measured with ContainerSandbox argv (Work 017, scripts/limits_qualify.py, tests/v3/test_rc05_container_limits.py): memory 64m -> 512 MiB allocation OOMKilled (rc 137), in-limit allocation succeeds; pids 32 -> fork refused after 30 (EAGAIN) with container and engine alive; --cpus applied (NanoCpus). Not measured: CPU throttling under load, podman (not installed).
